comment: Read from src/CognitiveShift.cpp at commit fb01326, the commit whose plugin.json carries the installed 2.11.1, alongside docs/Cella_Manual.md written for 2.11.0. The manual's account matches the code. Two things it does not spell out. The EDIT button does not merely enable manual entry: CognitiveShift.cpp:269 skips the clock test entirely while it is on, so a running clock is ignored until it is switched off again. And the DAC attenuverters run -1 to 1 rather than 0 to 1 (CognitiveShift.cpp:110 to 113), so a converter output can be inverted. The self-patch handling at CognitiveShift.cpp:203 to 211 reads the source module's previous bit state when that source was clocked on the same frame, which is the timing compensation the manual describes.
